scope: Same-scenario before/after observation; no sample-count equality assumption and no hardware-latency claim
units: milliseconds; positive late / negative early; wall time uses actual playback rate

beforeOnly.reason: The timely after crossing is within 350ms of seek to 2200ms, so it is excluded; the delayed before observation fell outside that window.
The timely after crossing is within 350ms of offset change; the delayed before observation fell outside that window.

afterOnly.reason: Before normal phase ended at pause before its sampled local owner reached this onset; its highlight occurred in pause.
Before resume phase ended at seek near this onset; no steady same-phase observation was recorded.
Before seek phase ended at rate control before its sampled local owner reached this onset; subsequent control window excluded.
Before rate phase ended at offset control before its sampled local owner reached this onset; subsequent control window excluded.
Before resume phase ended at seek near this onset; no steady same-phase observation was recorded.

transitionAnalysis.classification: Offline native media/rate transition inspection; no new playback authority or claimed browser-internal causal trace

run3.interpretation: The send anchor is paired to native currentTime within sub-ms rounding. Subsequent local native currentTime itself differs from linear rate=1.25 extrapolation during transition; this supports a native/media transition component rather than a stale publication position. Renderer rAF sampling, cross-window interpolation and millisecond generatedAt rounding prevent attributing the full tail to a specific browser internal stage.

final.interpretation: The send anchor is paired to native currentTime within sub-ms rounding. Subsequent local native currentTime itself differs from linear rate=1.25 extrapolation during transition; this supports a native/media transition component rather than a stale publication position. Renderer rAF sampling, cross-window interpolation and millisecond generatedAt rounding prevent attributing the full tail to a specific browser internal stage.

seekBoundary.classification: Discontinuous seek boundary is not uniquely pairable across renderer rAF observations; retained original control-summary -6825ms is not 6825ms elapsed latency
seekBoundary.interpretation: Output old frame shares control timestamp to 0.1ms precision, before new local native sample at +0.7ms and before fresh publication at +0.6ms. Next output sample at +4.2ms has correct new glyph. Nearest-discontinuity pairing chooses post-seek media for old boundary frame; ordering cannot be established from these samples.
